issues.on_page: Other sources 14,098 (p6: 5200 Transfers 12,494 + 5690 Other nonrevenue receipts 1,604)
issues.issue: 12,494 of this statement receipt is printed as 'Transfers' on the General Fund schedule (from the Depreciation Fund, both inside the statement's General column). In the combined column the Depreciation Fund's 'Other local receipts' 12,494 was eliminated instead, so the line is defensible as external money, but it is labelled a transfer at source
